name: a4s-context-expert
description: Jev-guided deterministic compaction for Claude Code with the shared adaptive trigger policy and keep/truncate/drop transcript selection.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key for Jev. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction (the first message is always kept).

triggerMode.title: Auto-compact trigger mode
triggerMode.description: off | hint | auto. 'hint' asks the user to run /compact and does not compact. 'auto' compacts after a positive shared-policy decision. 'off' disables the trigger.

minimumContextRatio.title: Legacy minimum context ratio
minimumContextRatio.description: Validated compatibility setting. The shared adaptive policy computes its token floor and ceiling from the model context window.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history; below it, fall back to the native summary.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.
